repos_data.description: A native macOS app for managing Apple's container - build images, run machines, and tail logs from a real GUI.
Native macOS workspace for Apple's container runtime. Browse, run, build and clean up Linux containers with live resource gauges, a built-in terminal and a local MLX chat playground.
Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents in a local VM on a clone of your project, then review their changes like a pull request. Mac app, CLI for Linux and Windows.
dockup - interactive TUI to install, harden and maintain Docker Engine, Compose v2, NVIDIA Container Toolkit and Apple container. One command, checksum-verified.
